reason: A thin DeepSeek Harness bridge for delegating browser automation tasks to the Browser Use Cloud API, including navigation, clicks, text entry, form filling, and data extraction.

summaries.zh: 通过 Browser Use 云 API 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页浏览自动化，可执行打开页面、点击、输入、填表和数据提取任务。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness bridge that delegates browser automation tasks such as opening pages, clicking, typing, filling forms, and extracting data to the Browser Use Cloud API.

capabilities: Submits browser tasks to the Browser Use Cloud API
Can open web pages, click elements, enter text, fill forms, and extract data through the delegated browser service
Requires a Browser Use API key and returns the raw run result
